name: FOLD
tagline: We design and build one-off cakes, and price them on the page.
taxNote: Every price here includes 7% VAT, the reduced German rate for prepared food.
_commission: The numbers a real studio keeps in its head and never puts on the site. Every one of them is quoted back to the customer on the spec sheet.

commission.note: One of us builds it start to finish, which is why we take four a week and ask for ten days.

delivery.note: Driven flat and level across Berlin, and set up on site if the piece needs it.

allergenStatement: One bench. Gluten, dairy, egg, nuts and soya cross it every day, so nothing leaves here certified free of them. Put the allergy in the brief — it is a design constraint like any other, and we will design around it or say it cannot be done.

voice.headline: One-off cakes, priced on the page.
voice.lede: A commission is a cake designed with you and built on our bench — for a wedding, a launch, a birthday. Answer six questions and the price appears as you go, instead of arriving by email next week.

work.alt: A three-tier cake, pale on a black field, every swag piped by hand
work.title: A wedding, Kreuzberg
work.note: Three tiers, one colour, every line put on by hand.

work.alt: A single tier in deep green, raked in ripples, with gold pearls across the top edge
work.title: A launch, Mitte
work.note: One tier, one green, and gold on the top edge only.

work.alt: A white tier with wildflowers piped in orange and ochre, on a terracotta stand
work.title: A sixtieth, Neukölln
work.note: Her garden, piped flower by flower from a photograph.

bench.caption: One of us builds it, start to finish.

gifting.note: We leave the prices off everything in the box and write the card by hand.
